Girard Partners LTD Holding in Apple (AAPL) Has Lowered by $340,873; Quantitative Investment Management Has Increased Invesco Plc (IVZ) Holding by $7.69 Million as Valuation Declined
May 13, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Quantitative Investment Management Llc increased its stake in Invesco Plc (IVZ) by 1535.97% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Quantitative Investment Management Llc bought 213,500 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.41% with the market. The hedge fund held 227,400 shares of the investment managers company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.31 million, up from 13,900 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Quantitative Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Invesco Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $11.58 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.21% or $0.06 during the last trading session, reaching $28.2. About 2.69M shares traded. Invesco Ltd. (NYSE:IVZ) has risen 4.53% since May 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 7.02% the S&P500.
Girard Partners Ltd decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 1.34% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Girard Partners Ltd sold 2,017 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 148,391 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $25.11 million, down from 150,408 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Girard Partners Ltd who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $926.95 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.38% or $0.72 during the last trading session, reaching $188.59. About 25.70M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
